title: Signed Claim Credit, Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier and Elite
content:
On the Paystride Visa Payroll Card Premier and Elite plans, the signed claim credit is the claimed transfer less the amount withheld for the cardholder's liability, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent once at the end.

## Definitions

- **Claimed transfer.** The claim's disputed amount, less any ATM owner surcharge rebate posted on the claimed transaction, never below zero.
- **Cardholder's liability.** The liability limit less the liability already charged on the same loss, never below zero, or the disputed amount if that is smaller. The liability limit is the plan's liability cap for a loss reported on time, and nothing is already charged.
- **Amount withheld.** The lesser of that liability and the plan's liability cap for a loss reported on time. That cap is the most Regulation E lets be withheld from a provisional credit.

## Order

Any adjustment that replaces a figure of this method applies first, before the credit is figured. Any adjustment that adds an amount to the credit applies after it, added to the credit as figured, which stands at no less than zero. The credit is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs; liability cap for a timely report 50.00)

| Disputed amount | Surcharge rebate on the transaction | Claimed transfer | Liability | Withheld | Signed claim credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 412.37 | none | 412.37 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 362.37 |
| 186.20 | 2.65 | 183.55 | 50.00 | 50.00 | 133.55 |
| 41.90 | 3.10 | 38.80 | 41.90 | 41.90 | 0.00 |

In the last row the claimed transfer less the amount withheld is below zero, so the credit stands at zero.
